# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V3020 test_unhandled_effect"
description: "Tests run under deterministic default handlers for Clock, Random, Env, Console and Log (design §5.8)."
---

An error from the `effect` phase. `sakura explain V3020` prints this explanation offline.

Tests run under deterministic default handlers for `Clock`, `Random`, `Env`, `Console` and
`Log` (design §5.8). Any other effect used in a test must be handled inside the test with
`with`, usually by a fake handler from std or one the test module declares.

Wrong:

```sakura
effect Db { fn count() -> Int }
test "counts rows" { expect_eq(Db.count(), 0) }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn empty_db() -> Handler<Db> { handler Db { fn count() { 0 } } }
test "counts rows" { with empty_db() { expect_eq(Db.count(), 0) } }
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V3020_test_unhandled_effect.fixed.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V3020_test_unhandled_effect.fixed.sakura), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
effect Db {
  fn count() -> Int
}

fn empty_db() -> Handler<Db> {
  handler Db {
    fn count() { 0 }
  }
}

test "counts rows" { with empty_db() { expect_eq(Db.count(), 0) } }
```
